summary: The agent loaded subagent-driven-development and ran a pre-flight scan. It asked one question about the plan's tests, and I answered "Proceed as you recommend." It then built all four tasks, each as implement → review, then ran a final whole-branch review and loaded finishing-a-development-branch. When it offered the merge/PR/keep options I replied "Keep the branch as-is." The controller's conversation was compacted 13 times, starting during Task 1. After each compaction it re-read SKILL.md and the ledger and carried on with the task loop. The finished code has 66 tests and all pass.
reasoning: All four acceptance criteria are confirmed from files on disk, git history, npm test output and the timestamps in the session logs. The task loop (implement → review → next task) held through 13 compactions. The final whole-branch review ran, and the session ended in the finishing skill with the branch kept as-is.

observations.description: Startup showed several dialogs before the prompt was usable: theme, security notes, folder trust, a 'Newer Opus model available' upgrade prompt and the bypass-permissions warning. The upgrade prompt said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the header then showed 'Opus 5.5'.

Before dispatching anything, the controller asked a multiple-choice question about whether the plan's test code or its prose should govern (unused PASSAGE constants, untested behaviours). The question is reasonable, but it pauses an unattended run. I answered through the free-text option.

The Task 2 implementer said its 36 tests were '8 from Task 1'. Task 1 had actually committed 22. The controller caught this by re-running npm test and called it a 'breakdown slip', so subagent self-reports can be inaccurate.

The controller's conversation was compacted 13 times in about 18 minutes, often twice per task. After each one it re-read SKILL.md and the ledger. It stayed on track, but this costs a lot of time and tokens.

The final summary lists 'Codex checks skipped… 5 unreviewed items are queued; say "run the review sweep"'. It also mentions a 'Safety alert, harmless' about .claude/settings.json being mentioned in reviewer output. Both may confuse users who don't know what they refer to.

Only 6 of the 9 subagents produced a task-notification in the main log. Reviews 2–4 seem to have completed while a compaction was running. The controller recovered by checking git state and reading the output file, but the engineers should confirm that notifications aren't being lost during compaction.
Near the end the status bar showed '✔ Update installed · Restart to update', which is unrelated to the task.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, everything is committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js line 141: `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ contains readingTimeMinutes.test.js, sentenceCount.test.js, topWords.test.js and wordCount.test.js. git log has 9701651 wordCount, 0f472d7 sentenceCount, 1862591 topWords and b374408 readingTimeMinutes. `git status --short` printed nothing. npm test: `ℹ tests 66 … ℹ pass 66 ℹ fail 0`

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Start/end timestamps from the subagent logs: Impl T1 21:24:12–21:24:51 → Review T1 21:26:11–21:26:27 → Impl T2 21:27:49–21:28:25 → Review T2 21:29:02–21:29:18 → Impl T3 21:30:12–21:31:55 → Review T3 21:32:33–21:32:49 → Impl T4 21:34:19–21:35:05 → Review T4 21:36:24–21:36:36. Every reviewer's final message says `**Task quality:** Approved`. Compactions happened between these steps (for example 21:25:28, 21:27:17 and 21:29:30), and the loop held.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Main log: `2026-11-04T21:38:06.030Z Agent Final whole-branch review`, dispatched after Review T4. That subagent finished at 21:39:10, and its last message says `**Ready to merge?** Yes`. On screen: `Final review: the whole-branch review found nothing to fix.`

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Main log: `21:39:26.696Z Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`. The screen showed `Implementation complete. What would you like to do? 1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is`. After I replied, the agent said: `The branch feature/textstats stays as it is, at commit b374408, with nothing uncommitted.`
